# Data Source: tfe_registry_artifact_tags

Use this data source to retrieve the tags associated with a registry artifact.

## Example Usage

```csharp
using Constructs;
using HashiCorp.Cdktf;
/*Provider bindings are generated by running cdktf get.
See https://cdk.tf/provider-generation for more details.*/
using Gen.Providers.Tfe;
class MyConvertedCode : TerraformStack
{
    public MyConvertedCode(Construct scope, string name) : base(scope, name)
    {
        var dataTfeRegistryModuleExample =
        new DataTfeRegistryModule.DataTfeRegistryModule(this, "example", new DataTfeRegistryModuleConfig {
            ModuleProvider = "aws",
            Name = "my-module",
            Organization = "my-org-name"
        });
        var dataTfeRegistryArtifactTagsExample =
        new DataTfeRegistryArtifactTags.DataTfeRegistryArtifactTags(this, "example_1", new Struct {
            Artifact = new [] { new Struct {
                Id = dataTfeRegistryModuleExample.Id,
                Type = "registry-module"
            } }
        });
        /*This allows the Terraform resource name to match the original name. You can remove the call if you don't need them to match.*/
        dataTfeRegistryArtifactTagsExample.OverrideLogicalId("example");
        new TerraformOutput(this, "module_tags", new TerraformOutputConfig {
            Value = dataTfeRegistryArtifactTagsExample.Tags
        });
    }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `Artifact` (Attributes) The registry artifact to retrieve tags for. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--artifact))

### Read-Only

- `Id` (String) The ID of this data source, in the format <artifact_type>/<artifact_id>.
- `Tags` (Attributes Set) The list of tags associated with the registry artifact. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

<a id="nestedatt--artifact"></a>
### Nested Schema for `Artifact`

Required:

- `Id` (String) The ID of the registry artifact.
- `Type` (String) The type of the registry artifact.


<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `Tags`

Read-Only:

- `Key` (String) The key of the tag.
- `Value` (String) The value of the tag.
